protocol.loss: actual-open binary BCE + 0.25 four-class CE + 0.10 counterfactual BCE
protocol.augmentation: One uniform non-unit factor per base event per epoch; not independent real trades
protocol.architecture_selection: mean over two folds of 1 - selection Brier / calibration-prevalence constant Brier; tie name
protocol.ensemble: mean three raw success logits, then independent calibration-year positive-slope Platt
protocol.calibration: unweighted monotone Platt using actual opens only
protocol.qualification: Both single-seed development folds and final ensemble must pass fixed 200-signal/50-day/10-day-block CI precision>.5 and net proxy>0 gate; not live authorization
protocol.test_policy: 2025+ excluded from training/selection; later comparison is REUSED historical evaluation, never fresh OOS
protocol.deployment: No automatic promotion; original checkpoints and trading settings unchanged
